name: OpenClaw Stream
description: Low-latency web previews for OpenClaw Mattermost replies.

settings_schema.header: Only configured OpenClaw Mattermost bot IDs can publish transient text snapshots.
settings_schema.footer: The post message remains authoritative for clients without the web app.

settings.help_text: Comma-separated Mattermost bot user IDs authorized to publish OpenClaw stream snapshots. Empty denies all publishers.
